annotations.description: Extreme CPU pressure can cause slow serialization and poor performance from the kube-apiserver and etcd. When this happens, there is a risk of clients seeing non-responsive API requests which are issued again causing even more CPU pressure. It can also cause failing liveness probes due to slow etcd responsiveness on the backend. annotations.description: The memory utilization per instance within control plane nodes influence the stability, and responsiveness of the cluster. This can lead to cluster instability and slow responses from kube-apiserver or failing requests especially on etcd. Moreover, OOM kill is expected which negatively influences the pod scheduling. If this happens on container level, the descheduler will not be able to detect it, as it works on the pod level. To fix this, increase memory of the affected node of control plane nodes.
annotations.summary: Extreme memory utilization per node within control plane nodes is extremely high, and could impact responsiveness and stability.

rules.name: HighOverallControlPlaneMemory

configuration that does not contain the latest schema version. It is recommended to update the schema
configuration to update the schema version to the latest version in the future.
annotations.summary: One or more of the deployed LokiStacks contains an outdated storage schema configuration.

annotations.message: The Node Feature Discovery Operator is degraded. Review the "NodeFeatureDiscovery" CustomResource object for further details.

rules.name: openshift_logging:lokistack_info:count
rules.query: count by (stack_namespace, size, tenancy_mode, object_storage_type, credential_mode, schema_version) (lokistack_info{namespace="openshift-operators-redhat"})

rules.name: openshift_logging:lokistack_ingestion_discarded_bytes_per_second:sum
rules.query: sum by (stack_namespace, size, reason) (label_replace(label_replace(rate(loki_discarded_bytes_total{namespace="openshift-operators-redhat"}[5m]), "stack_name", "$1", "pod", "(.+)-distributor-.+"), "stack_namespace", "$1", "namespace", "(.+)") * on (stack_namespace) group_left (size) lokistack_info{namespace="openshift-operators-redhat"})

annotations.summary: High memory usage on VM
